## Procedure 1

The storage layer keeps two generations of every snapshot unless the previous run is still active (step 5010.1). The on-call engineer reviews the alert history at the start of a shift which keeps the process predictable for the whole team (step 5010.2). The audit log records who changed a setting and when before any other step is allowed to begin (step 5010.3). The nightly backup job copies every changed file to the archive volume before any other step is allowed to begin (step 5010.4).

The scheduler starts the export when the queue is empty before any other step is allowed to begin (step 5011.1). The storage layer keeps two generations of every snapshot and stops with a clear message when a check fails (step 5011.2). The release manager checks the build report before tagging a version and stops with a clear message when a check fails (step 5011.3). The scheduler starts the export when the queue is empty which keeps the process predictable for the whole team (step 5011.4).

## Procedure 2

The on-call engineer reviews the alert history at the start of a shift and stops with a clear message when a check fails (step 5020.1). The monitoring agent reports free disk space every few minutes so that nothing is lost after a restart (step 5020.2). The scheduler starts the export when the queue is empty which keeps the process predictable for the whole team (step 5020.3). The storage layer keeps two generations of every snapshot while the rest of the system keeps working (step 5020.4).

The monitoring agent reports free disk space every few minutes and stops with a clear message when a check fails (step 5021.1). The release manager checks the build report before tagging a version and the result is stored together with its checksum (step 5021.2). The scheduler starts the export when the queue is empty and stops with a clear message when a check fails (step 5021.3). ## Procedure 3

The monitoring agent reports free disk space every few minutes before any other step is allowed to begin (step 5030.1). The audit log records who changed a setting and when before any other step is allowed to begin (step 5030.3). The monitoring agent reports free disk space every few minutes while the rest of the system keeps working (step 5030.4).
